name: goal
description: Manage the current autonomous goal for this session. Never create, replace, or resume the goal; those operations require the /goal command or the UI; never change the objective text. When a goal is enabled, maintain its status: use get to inspect, report after a blocker, complete after verified achievement, and stop/clear only on explicit request. Do not report ordinary progress. Pending family reviews pause no-progress accounting. Use report only after encountering a blocker, attempting reasonable self-resolution, and remaining unable to progress; every report consumes one no-progress retry attempt. Active background subagents or shells are unfinished work, not automatic no progress. Use complete only after the goal is achieved and verified; completion is agent-owned. When the goal request names a check (a ./ or ../ script path ending in .sh, .bash, .zsh, .ps1, .cmd or .bat, or a backticked command of two or more words), complete and update to completed are rejected after a completed edit, write or patch in this Session or its descendants until a shell run of that check after the latest such edit has passed; the rejection names the check to rerun. A completion rejection identical to the previous one, with no other tool call, check run, edit or descendant work in between, consumes one no-progress retry attempt. Use rework with unit, reason and state opened when a failed check, regression or rejected result reopens finished work, and with state resolved plus evidence once its check passes; rework is neither a no-progress report nor progress narration and never stops the goal. An unresolved failure in this Session's own iteration also blocks completion. Do not use set to create a goal; it will be rejected.

action.description: Goal action: get, update status, report no progress, record rework, complete, or stop/clear the current goal

unit.description: Rework unit: the file, check, feature or child result being reopened or resolved

reason.description: Rework reason: the failed check, regression or contradicting evidence

state.description: Rework state: opened when evidence reopens the unit, resolved when its check passes

evidence.description: Required for resolved rework: the check that now passes
